text:
mina: FYI vendor just slid a temporary pricing cap on spot H100s in eu-west1 — effective immediately for at least 72h. Can we do a short swap of the demo pool to uk-west to avoid potential throttles? Need a quick cost/impact check.

leo: How many slots would we move? Also do we have warm capacity in uk-west for the same SKU?

mina: Thinking 24 demo slots (half the pool). We need them for the external demo tomorrow 09:00 CET.

samir: Quick check — running infractl to see live counts.

```
$ infractl pools list --region eu-west1 --sku h100 --status active
pool-demo-eu-west1   sku=h100   active=48   reserved=0
pool-standby-eu-west sku=h100   active=16   reserved=0
```

samir: uk-west shows small warm buffer but can absorb 24 with a brief reassign:

```
$ infractl pools list --region uk-west1 --sku h100
pool-demo-uk-west    sku=h100   active=8    warm=32   reserved=4
```

leo: Cost note — moving 24 to uk-west increases expected spot spend ~€1.1k/day (estimate) due to regional premium. Also we need vendor signoff for cross-region swap?

ana-vendor: (ana-vendor) We can facilitate the swap from vendor side but require PO ref and short amendment for cross-region billing. If you cc billing@vendor we can proceed same-day. :white_check_mark:

mina: tagging @finance (not in channel) — can someone confirm PO amend? If finance can't do same-day we need fallback: reduce demo concurrency to 12.

leo: I can sponsor a one-off approval up to €2k for this event — will send email to billing@vendor with PO# RED-2026-091. Please proceed after confirmation. :+1:

ops-bot: terraform plan queued for pool reassign (PR 12345). No changes will apply until PR LGTM.

samir: Filed PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/12345 — moves 24 slots to uk-west pool, adds region tag and transient routing rule. Adding smoke test and 1hr canary window.

mina: Awesome — schedule canary tonight 22:00 UTC. If vendor confirms PO by EOD, we go ahead. Otherwise we run reduced concurrency tomorrow.

ana-vendor: Confirmed on our side — billing@vendor acknowledged PO RED-2026-091 and will send amendment. ETA 3h. :shipit:

leo: :thumbsup: I'll monitor costs and pause if the premium spikes. Samir will run canary and report metrics to #realtime.

samir: Will run smoke + perf run at 22:00 UTC and post summary here.

mina: Thanks team.
